summary:
Imagine having to make one guess a year  for the crap you’re gonna plant and if it fails it does miserably affecting you economically
Farmers still have great tool crop rotation
Planting the best crop for the soul in which maximize the yield and helps the crop for next year 
Unfortunately, crop rotation  can be financial burden for the farmers as it cost so much for soil sensors and soil tests 
That way we created a ATHAR a tool that scans farmers field for nitrogen levels and water level relying on 45 years of NASA data to find the best crop to plant
It asks for for the previous crops and next year crops you want to plant then ask you for the location 
Which relying on our data finds the soil type 
Nitrogen levels and water percentage
And then calculate the best crops to be planted this year to yield the maximum ecological and financial result
details:
First, you pinpoint your land location on the map

Then using NASA data, it finds the water level and nitrogen level in that soil as well as the soil type

Then the tool asks you for previous year crop as well as what are you planning to plant next year

Then using nasa data calculates the best crop to be planted in financial and ecological side
